subject: art-design

moments.title: Daguerreotype announced
moments.body: The French Academy of Sciences publishes Daguerre's process. France purchases the rights and gives them to the world.
moments.takeaway: Photography began as a state-sponsored gift.

moments.title: Decisive moment
moments.body: Cartier-Bresson articulates a philosophy of photography as the capture of fleeting visual order. His book 'Images a la sauvette' appears in 1952.
moments.takeaway: Photography developed its own aesthetic vocabulary.

moments.title: Untitled Film Stills
moments.body: Sherman photographs herself as imaginary actresses in 1950s-60s films, beginning a long inquiry into the constructed self.
moments.takeaway: Photography became a tool for theorising identity, not just recording it.

now.title: Photography now
now.body: Phone cameras outproduce all earlier photography combined. AI image generation reframes what 'taking a picture' means.
now.open_questions: What counts as photography when the image is synthesised?

reflection: Photography has been declared 'finished' at every technological turn and never has been.
